/**
 * Backlog API関連の関数
 */

/**
 * Fetches project list from Backlog API
 * @param apiKey - The Backlog API key
 * @param domain - Optional domain for the Backlog instance (default: backlog.com)
 * @returns Array of project objects or error object
 */
function getBacklogProjects(apiKey: string, domain?: string): BacklogProject[] | BacklogError {
  try {
    // If a domain is not provided, use the default backlog.jp domain
    const backlogDomain = domain || 'backlog.jp';

    // Backlog API endpoint for getting the project list
    // According to the documentation: https://developer.nulab.com/ja/docs/backlog/api/2/get-project-list/
    const url = `https://${backlogDomain}/api/v2/projects?apiKey=${apiKey}`;

    // Make the HTTP request
    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
      method: 'get',
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    // Check if the request was successful
    const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
    if (responseCode !== 200) {
      return {
        error: `API request failed with status code: ${responseCode}. ${response.getContentText()}`
      };
    }

    // Parse the JSON response
    const projects = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
    return projects;
  } catch (error) {
    // Handle any errors
    return {
      error: `Error fetching projects: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Saves the Backlog API key to user properties
 * @param apiKey - The Backlog API key to save
 */
function saveApiKey(apiKey: string): void {
  PropertiesService.getUserProperties().setProperty('backlogApiKey', apiKey);
}

/**
 * Retrieves the Backlog API key from user properties
 * @returns The saved API key or empty string if not found
 */
function getApiKey(): string {
  return PropertiesService.getUserProperties().getProperty('backlogApiKey') || '';
}

/**
 * Saves the Backlog domain to user properties
 * @param domain - The Backlog domain to save
 */
function saveDomain(domain: string): void {
  PropertiesService.getUserProperties().setProperty('backlogDomain', domain);
}

/**
 * Retrieves the Backlog domain from user properties
 * @returns The saved domain or empty string if not found
 */
function getDomain(): string {
  return PropertiesService.getUserProperties().getProperty('backlogDomain') || '';
}

/**
 * Fetches Git repositories for a specific Backlog project
 * @param projectId - The ID of the Backlog project
 * @param apiKey - The Backlog API key
 * @param domain - Optional domain for the Backlog instance
 * @returns Array of repository objects or error object
 */
function getBacklogRepositories(projectId: string, apiKey: string, domain?: string): BacklogRepository[] | BacklogError {
  try {
    // If a domain is not provided, use the default backlog.jp domain
    const backlogDomain = domain || 'backlog.jp';

    // Backlog API endpoint for getting the Git repositories list
    // According to the documentation: https://developer.nulab.com/ja/docs/backlog/api/2/get-list-of-git-repositories/
    const url = `https://${backlogDomain}/api/v2/projects/${projectId}/git/repositories?apiKey=${apiKey}`;

    // Make the HTTP request
    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
      method: 'get',
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    // Check if the request was successful
    const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
    if (responseCode !== 200) {
      return {
        error: `API request failed with status code: ${responseCode}. ${response.getContentText()}`
      };
    }

    // Parse the JSON response
    const repositories = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
    return repositories;
  } catch (error) {
    // Handle any errors
    return {
      error: `Error fetching repositories: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches pull requests for a specific Backlog repository
 * @param projectId - The ID of the Backlog project
 * @param repoId - The ID of the Git repository
 * @param apiKey - The Backlog API key
 * @param domain - Optional domain for the Backlog instance
 * @returns Array of pull request objects or error object
 */
function getBacklogPullRequests(projectId: string, repoId: string, apiKey: string, domain?: string): BacklogPullRequest[] | BacklogError {
  try {
    // If a domain is not provided, use the default backlog.jp domain
    const backlogDomain = domain || 'backlog.jp';

    // Backlog API endpoint for getting the pull request list
    // According to the documentation: https://developer.nulab.com/ja/docs/backlog/api/2/get-pull-request-list/
    const url = `https://${backlogDomain}/api/v2/projects/${projectId}/git/repositories/${repoId}/pullRequests?apiKey=${apiKey}`;

    // Make the HTTP request
    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
      method: 'get',
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    // Check if the request was successful
    const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
    if (responseCode !== 200) {
      return {
        error: `API request failed with status code: ${responseCode}. ${response.getContentText()}`
      };
    }

    // Parse the JSON response
    const pullRequests = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
    return pullRequests;
  } catch (error) {
    // Handle any errors
    return {
      error: `Error fetching pull requests: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches comments for a specific pull request
 * @param projectId - The ID of the Backlog project
 * @param repoId - The ID of the Git repository
 * @param pullRequestNumber - The Number of the pull request
 * @param apiKey - The Backlog API key
 * @param domain - Optional domain for the Backlog instance
 * @returns Array of pull request comment objects or error object
 */
function getBacklogPullRequestComments(projectId: string, repoId: string, pullRequestNumber: string, apiKey: string, domain?: string): BacklogPullRequestComment[] | BacklogError {
  try {
    const backlogDomain = domain || 'backlog.jp';

    // According to the documentation: https://developer.nulab.com/ja/docs/backlog/api/2/get-pull-request-comment/
    const url = `https://${backlogDomain}/api/v2/projects/${projectId}/git/repositories/${repoId}/pullRequests/${pullRequestNumber}/comments?order=asc&apiKey=${apiKey}`;

    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
      method: 'get',
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    const responseCode = response.getResponseCode();
    if (responseCode !== 200) {
      return {
        error: `API request failed with status code: ${responseCode}. ${response.getContentText()}`
      };
    }

    return JSON.parse(response.getContentText()) as BacklogPullRequestComment[];
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      error: `Error fetching pull request comments: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
    };
  }
}
